log.title: Sworn in as President
log.body: Golden Fixture takes the oath of office. Review the budget and your cabinet: the nation is watching your first decisions.

log.title: Embassy opened in United States
log.body: A permanent mission now works in United States (₹15 crore a month). Relations improve and proposals are likelier to succeed.

log.title: Land allotment scandal
log.body: Prime public land was allotted to well-connected developers at a fraction of its value, say auditors.

log.title: Myanmar agents probe your defences
log.body: Foreign agents mapped sensitive sites before they were noticed. Readiness suffers while the leaks are plugged. Counter-intelligence reduces the risk.

log.title: Friction with Norway
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Norway. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Anti-corruption bill
log.body: A cross-party group offers a bill to give the anti-corruption agency stronger powers and tougher penalties.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade
log.body: The service chiefs suggest a large parade to show the forces to the public and raise morale.

log.title: Land allotment scandal: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. A committee is formed. The story drags on for months.

log.title: Quarterly cabinet report
log.body: Best run: Industry & Infra (104% efficiency). Weakest: Disaster Mgmt (74%).

log.title: China spy ring uncovered
log.body: Counter-intelligence caught agents of China probing military sites. No damage was done.

log.title: Germany proposes a trade contract
log.body: Germany offers a 3-year industry contract worth ₹1,35,900 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Invitation to host an investor summit
log.body: Industry bodies propose a global investor summit. It would be expensive, but could bring in factories and funds.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The parade is shelved and units keep to their training schedule.

log.title: Ghost beneficiaries in welfare schemes
log.body: An audit finds millions of rupees paid out every month to people who do not exist.

log.title: Disinformation campaign
log.body: A flood of fake videos and forwarded messages is stoking panic and distrust online.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You keep your distance. The opposition asks what you are afraid of.

log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline. The idea quietly dies.

log.title: Ghost beneficiaries in welfare schemes: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Nothing changes, and the money keeps leaking.

log.title: Global slowdown
log.body: Major trading partners are slowing sharply. Export orders are drying up and factories are warning of short-time work.

log.title: Disinformation campaign: no decision

log.title: City flooding in the West
log.body: Record rain has swamped streets, power lines and underpasses in the West. Commuters are stranded and shops are shut.

log.title: Weak monsoon
log.body: Monsoon rainfall is running well below normal. Farm output is at risk and food prices are starting to climb.

log.title: Police reform demanded
log.body: After a controversial arrest, civil-rights groups demand sweeping police reform: body cameras, training and oversight.

log.title: Senior adviser resigns
log.body: A trusted adviser has resigned, citing differences over direction. Leaks about infighting follow.

log.title: Land acquisition protests in the North
log.body: Villagers in the North are blocking surveyors from a planned industrial corridor, saying compensation is far too low.

log.title: Weak monsoon: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The rains do not recover in time. Farm output falls and food prices rise.

log.title: Police reform demanded: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You reject the demand. The criticism gets louder.

log.title: Rift with the defence minister
log.body: The defence minister is openly at odds with you over strategy and spending.

log.body: The organisers of a major trade expo want India as host. Delegations from dozens of countries would visit, with the contracts and publicity that follow.

log.title: Murmurs in the barracks
log.body: Senior officers are grumbling about pay, promotions and the government's direction. Some talk of "restoring order".

log.body: Reports say relief grain and blankets meant for the East were sold in the open market. Survivors are furious.

log.title: Vote at the UN: Saudi Arabia seeks India’s support
log.body: Saudi Arabia has asked India to back its draft resolution at the General Assembly. Other delegations are lobbying the other way.

log.title: Goodwill from Ethiopia
log.body: Ethiopia praised India’s role in a regional forum. Relations warm a little.

log.title: Friction with Greece

log.body: Farmers from the East have set out for the capital, demanding better support prices and debt relief.

log.body: A friendly industrial power offers a batch of modern equipment on favourable terms, if you act this quarter.

log.title: Annual report 2026
log.body: The government closed 2026 with a deficit of ₹8,38,773 crore. Growth 5.7%, inflation 4.2%, unemployment 7.7%, debt 52.9% of GDP. Approval stands at 32.1%.

log.title: New cabinet candidates
log.body: A fresh set of candidates is available for every ministry. Review them in the Cabinet room.

log.title: Allegations against a minister: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You defend the minister. Public anger grows and corruption feels entrenched.

log.body: Cyber teams detect an intrusion into logistics systems. The origin is hidden behind several countries.
